Shanghai Municipal Council Report 1934

Report for the Year 1934 and Budget for the Year 1935
Shanghai Municipal Council; Shanghai: Kelly & Walsh, 1935

All tables and lists are transcribed, including small tables set in the text, the figures printed on charts, the accounts and the budget (each department or sub-head of the financial statements and budget is a separate table); the prose, the photographs and graphs without printed figures are not. Table pages were found from contact sheets by Claude Sonnet 5.5; light pages were read once by Claude Haiku 5.5, dense pages and long schedules by Claude Sonnet 5.5. Not checked by eye. Printed totals were re-added by the readers: totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted. Figures that could not be read are marked [?] (22 cells); a few are at the edge of pages that the scan clips. The scan has no table of contents; the contents shown here are the report's sections.
